name: io.github.bithug01/greenpick
title: GreenPick
description: Greener, cheaper cloud infra decisions — carbon + cost + latency tradeoffs, in-editor.

environmentVariables.name: GREENPICK_CARBON_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Carbon data source: 'auto' (US->EIA, EU->ENTSO-E, else mock), 'mock', 'eia', 'entsoe', or 'electricitymaps'. Defaults to mock (offline, no keys).

environmentVariables.name: EIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free US EIA-930 grid data API key (optional; enables live US carbon).

environmentVariables.name: ENTSOE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free EU ENTSO-E grid data token (optional; enables live EU carbon + day-ahead forecast).

environmentVariables.name: ELECTRICITYMAPS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Electricity Maps API token (optional; used when GREENPICK_CARBON_SOURCE=electricitymaps).

environmentVariables.name: GREENPICK_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Cache lifetime for fetched grid data, in seconds.
